tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | 5+ years SAP Commerce, Java, Spring, OCC APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, B2B headless commerce, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, performance tuning, and techno-functional analysis bridging business and IT in agile international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: I am eager to join Mario Quirante because of its reputation for delivering cutting-edge SAP Commerce solutions. With 5+ years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built and scaled B2B platforms that drive revenue and customer satisfaction.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions at Rockwell Automation, covering product catalog, pricing and OCC headless APIs for B2B commerce.

bullets.label: Integration Leadership
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring seamless ERP/MDM synchronization.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Built robust REST and OCC web services for headless storefronts and third-party integrations, enhancing platform extensibility.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Bridged business and IT by analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and supporting UAT across international teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value.

tailoring.why_company: Mario Quirante’s focus on innovative SAP Commerce implementations aligns perfectly with my passion for building high-performance B2B platforms. I admire the company’s commitment to leveraging modern headless architectures and its collaborative, international environment, where my techno-functional expertise can directly contribute to delivering scalable, customer-centric solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help Mario Quirante accelerate its B2B digital commerce initiatives and drive measurable business impact.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the SAP Commerce role at Mario Quirante and would love to discuss how I can contribute. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position at Mario Quirante. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
